coordinates: All edges in crop pixels local to each padded row template; add line.x_origin_crop for crop x. whiteEdge denotes plateau edge even when gain<1.
field: darkOffset + gain * clamp((front50 - x)/feather + 0.5,0,1). darkOffset is endpoint/background calibration drift; replica normally uses gain*ramp only. frontDataInterval brackets >=0.6 and <=0.4 field samples without inventing observations in ink gaps.
uncertainty: Engineering uncertainty, not statistical CI. ±3 crop px for settled, well-sampled ramp; ≥8px for censored onset/tail. Report inferred extrapolated edges separately from data bounds. Events bracketed between 33.3667ms samples. Gain+front+width can be underdetermined at very first visible ink, and terminal width unidentifiable once all ink lit.
